goal: Prevents loss of not-yet-broadcast private transactions if a node restarts before broadcast completes
Helps operators and apps relying on sendrawtransaction with privatebroadcast=1
reviewability: Stale: draft, needs rebase, author silent for 199 days
Author opened a separate PR (#34707) pursuing a different design, suggesting this approach may be superseded
agreement: Concept ACK, benefits outweigh disk-storage concerns, though a retention-time option is missing (vasild)
Concept ACK but argues the approach doesn't go far enough versus a broadcast-pool design (craigraw)
Nonblocking objection: persisting broadcast data to disk changes the risk profile for broadcast-only nodes (tankyleo)
Author agrees a broader design may be better and is pursuing it in #34707 instead

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a real but narrow problem, losing a queued private-broadcast transaction on restart
Only matters to operators who opt in to privatebroadcast, a niche feature
Reviewer craigraw noted this restart-loss scenario is probably rare compared to a broader broadcast-pool need
Author's pivot to a separate broadcast-pool PR reduces this PR's standalone leverage
